newsitem.title: USA: US Midco gasoline, diesel prices track NYMEX lower.
newsitem.headline: US Midco gasoline, diesel prices track NYMEX lower.

text.p: U.S. Midcontinent spot unleaded gasoline and diesel prices eased on Friday, tracking a steep drop in underlying NYMEX futures prices in morning trade.
Refined product differentials in the Group Three and Chicago markets firmed across the board as traders continued to perceive a tightening in regional inventories, traders said.

But the firming differentials could not offset the more than 1.25 cent a gallon drop in June NYMEX heating oil and nearly 1.75 cent a gallon drop in front-month unleaded gasoline undercutting prices in the spot Midwest markets.
Group Three unleaded was bid 2.25 cents a gallon over June NYMEX unleaded for prompt May deliveries and 0.75 cent over the print for later deliveries, traders said.
Chicago unleaded was bid 0.50 cent a gallon over the print for prompt deliveries and remained even with the print for later deliveries. Premium was holding at a strong 5.50 cent a gallon higher.
Group Three high sulphur diesel for May deliveries was talked 6.25/6.50 cents a gallon over June NYMEX heating oil, with Chicago high sulphur bid 2.50/2.75 cents over the print.
